prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your case and what you need (trial experience, max settlement history, handling of catastrophic injury/death claims, language needs, fee structure, etc.). I can, however, help you find a great lawyer. Quick guidance and next steps:

How to pick the best lawyer for your case
- Look for car-accident and personal-injury specialists (not a general practice or only family law).  
- Trial experience and verdicts: if the insurer won’t offer a fair settlement, you want someone who will and has won in court.  
- Track record with cases like yours (serious injury, wrongful death, uninsured motorist, commercial vehicle, hit-and-run).  
- Reputation and peer recognition: AV Preeminent (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, American Association for Justice membership, peer reviews.  
- Client reviews and references.  
- Clear contingency fee terms (typical is 33–40% plus expenses) and willingness to advance case costs.  
- Good communication and responsiveness.  
- Local Cook County experience and familiarity with medical experts and local courts.

Where to look
- Illinois State Bar Association / Chicago Bar Association directories.  
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo for ratings and reviews.  
- American Association for Justice / local trial lawyer groups.  
- Referral from your primary care doctor, ER doctor, or trusted friends/family.

If you want, I can:
- Give a short list of top-rated Chicago personal injury firms and attorneys (I’ll pull current options and links), or  
- Recommend 3–5 lawyers near you if you tell me your ZIP code, the date/location of the crash, severity of injuries, whether the other driver was insured, and any other important details.

Which would you prefer?
